detector.description: Alerts when number of ready and available pods in Deployments have diverged
detector.name: K8S Cluster Deployment is not at spec
detector.programText:
A = data('k8s.deployment.desired').sum(by=['k8s.namespace.name', 'k8s.cluster.name', 'k8s.deployment.name']).publish(label='A', enable=False)
B = data('k8s.deployment.available').sum(by=['k8s.namespace.name', 'k8s.cluster.name', 'k8s.deployment.name']).publish(label='B', enable=False)
C = (B-A).publish(label='C', enable=False)
detect(when((C > threshold(0)) or (C < threshold(0)), lasting='5m', at_least=0.8), auto_resolve_after='1d').publish('K8S Cluster Deployment is not at spec')

rules.description: The value of Available - Desired is outside of 0 and 0 for 80% of 5m.
rules.detectLabel: K8S Cluster Deployment is not at spec
